What disciplined men
do on Sunday evenings
They plan the week in ten minutes. Three priorities, the important meetings, the training days. Monday feels calm when you already know exactly what matters most.
They prepare their clothes for the first two days. Shirts ironed, shoes clean, bag ready. Small preparation on Sunday removes stress from the busiest mornings of the week.
They cook one big meal for the next days. A pot of chili, roasted vegetables, rice. Having real food ready stops the late-night junk and saves money all week long.
They feed their mind before bed. I do five minutes of history, art or science on Sunday nights, and I start the week curious instead of dreading Monday.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app on Sunday nights. History, art, science. I start the week curious instead of dreading Monday.

slides.texte_overlay: They reset their space. Laundry done, desk cleared, kitchen clean. Walking into a tidy home on Monday evening feels like a gift from the version of you who planned ahead.
They call someone they care about. Parents, a grandparent, an old friend. Ending the weekend with a real conversation keeps the people who matter close all year.
They go to bed on time. No scrolling until one in the morning. A good night of sleep on Sunday is the single best way to start a strong, focused week.
